meta.note: Illustrative rebuild. 50 available points against vanilla's 59, same seven rows.

talents.name: Bloodletting
talents.text: Rend ignores armor; Overpower refreshes its duration; below 20% health it deals all remaining damage at once.

talents.name: Poise
talents.text: Dodged and parried attacks refund Rage; Overpower resets on a dodge; you cannot be disarmed in Battle Stance; Hamstring cannot be dispelled; Rage does not decay while a struck target lives.

talents.name: Concussion
talents.text: Thunder Clap also slows casting, spreads Rend to bleeding targets, and becomes usable in any stance.

talents.name: Headlong
talents.text: Charge is usable in combat when no enemy is within 8 yards, and interrupts spellcasting.

talents.name: Tactical Mastery
talents.text: Retain Rage through Battle, then Berserker, then Defensive; then no stance swap cooldown; then swapping stances reopens Overpower's window.

talents.name: Riposte Reading
talents.text: Overpower cannot be dodged or parried; its window opens on any miss rather than only a dodge.

talents.name: Battle Trance
talents.text: Three consecutive attacks without a miss makes your next Overpower or Execute free.

talents.name: Deep Wounds
talents.text: Critical strikes cause bleeding; refreshing carries remaining damage forward; the bleed jumps to a nearby enemy on death.

talents.name: Sweeping Strikes
talents.text: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Unchanged from vanilla.

talents.name: Weapon Mastery
talents.text: Effect determined by the equipped weapon rather than by the node. Axes bleed on crit, swords proc an extra attack, maces stun, polearms strike a second target behind the first.

talents.name: Opportunist
talents.text: Sweeping Strikes copies Overpower; its extra hits can trigger Deep Wounds.

talents.name: Rupture Line
talents.text: Execute refreshes your bleeds; bleeds below 20% tick twice as fast; a target dying while bleeding refunds the Rage spent on Execute.

talents.name: Mortal Cleave
talents.text: Cleave and Whirlwind apply Mortal Strike's healing reduction; it persists 4 seconds after the target leaves melee range. The sideways node.

talents.name: Sure Strike
talents.text: Your melee attacks can no longer be dodged, parried, or miss. Your melee attacks can no longer critically strike. The subtraction node.

talents.name: Second Wind
talents.text: Being stunned or rooted generates Rage; the second rank breaks the effect once per 30 seconds.

talents.name: Crippling Grip
talents.text: Hamstring may root; the root is not broken by your own bleed damage; Hamstring is free against a bleeding target.

talents.name: Death Sentence
talents.text: Execute refunds its Rage on a kill; usable below 35% against targets you have Rent; a kill by Execute resets Overpower.

talents.name: Unyielding
talents.text: Reduced stun duration, then reduced disarm duration, then you continue attacking for 2 seconds after a fear begins.

talents.name: Mortal Strike
talents.text: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage and wounds the target, reducing healing received. Unchanged from vanilla.
